body:
i did not expect to tear up today but here we are 🥹

the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame inducted Taylor — and the person who inducted her was Brad Paisley. an elder of the room she grew up writing in, welcoming her into it.

think about where this one started: a teenager in Nashville writing-rooms, songs nobody had heard yet. and now her name goes on that wall, next to the writers she learned from.

it's a songwriter's honour, not a pop-star one. that's the part that gets me — the industry that makes its name on the words saying hers belong.

tag the friend who's loved her writing since the very first album 💛
